in_sanskrit.name: Arkina
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Chariot of God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Arkina एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Arkina is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ark', which means chariot. In Hindu mythology, the gods travel in chariots pulled by horses or elephants. Therefore, the name Arkina symbolizes a divine being or a powerful spiritual force that carries one towards enlightenment.
